days.title: Natural Wonders of Brinzio
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Masso erratico di Brinzio
stops.detail: Erratic boulder of Brinzio: a large gneiss boulder transported and deposited by glaciers in the Intrino valley, on the northern slope of Campo dei Fiori.

stops.name: Cascata del Pesegh
stops.detail: Pesegh Waterfall: formed by the junction of the waters of the Brivola and Valmolina streams, Brinzio.

stops.name: Forre della Valganna
stops.detail: Valganna Gorges: deep incisions with steep walls, eroded by water, north of the Valganna Caves.

stops.name: Monte Martica
stops.detail: Monte Martica is also part of the C.d.F. complex; it can be traveled to the summit thanks to a military road and is connected to Monte Chiusarella.

stops.name: Marmitte dei giganti del torrente Vellone

stops.detail: Ceppo Spring: a karst spring active all year round, Santa Maria del Monte.
